title: Annotatio III §.VII: 1215 — Innocent III canonizes the name in his Lateran Council
pass_a_gloss: And in the following thirteenth Century, in the year 1215, it was canonized by Pope Innocent III in his Lateran Council.
pass_b_english: Next century, 1215: Pope Innocent III canonizes that name in his Lateran Council.
So the invented term Transsubstantiatio becomes a canon of the faith under Lateran IV.
source_text: Et Seculo seq. XIII. anno 1215. ab Innocentio III. Papa, in Lateranensi Concilio suo canonizatum est.
